description: This package contains OpenAI and Anthropic compatible HTTP server for Fuuga, to be used from tools like OpenCode.
releaseNotes: Version aligned with Fuuga 1.0.41. --semantic-cache reuses answers for requests that ask the same thing, confirmed by a judge; --rag-rerank mmr|cross|judge; --embedder and the side-model CPU options. Earlier versions: https://bitbucket.org/Thorium/fuuga/src/master/CHANGELOG.md
title: Fuuga.Server
